chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: Tell me, how did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله punish in cases of wine? He said: “He would strike with sandals, and he would increase it when the drinker was brought forward. Then the people continued increasing it until that settled at eighty; Ali عليه السلام indicated that to Umar.”

key_terms.بِٱلنِّعَالِ: with sandals, describing the instrument used in punishment
key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, the number on which the punishment came to rest
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: Imam Ali عليه السلام, whose indication is cited in fixing the punishment
key_terms.عُمَرَ: Umar, to whom Imam Ali عليه السلام indicated this matter
key_terms.يَضْرِبُ: to strike or administer corporal punishment
key_terms.ٱلشَّارِبِ: the drinker, meaning the one who consumed wine
key_terms.ٱلنَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, whose practice is being asked about
key_terms.ٱلْخَمْرِ: wine or intoxicant, the subject of the legal punishment

ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله punish for drinking wine, and how did the penalty become eighty lashes?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the punishment applied for drinking wine during the time of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and how its amount later came to be fixed at eighty. It presents a legal-historical report linking the established number to the indication of Imam Ali عليه السلام to Umar.
